study_type: Retrospective timeboxed optimization; historical outer results already known. No claim of independent confirmation.
fixed_evidence: Unchanged final_v2/fixed_evidence_without_gold.jsonl.gz, filtered by final_v3_prompt_clean exclusion before any split or fit.
graph: Original generic joint candidate graph, edit_scale=1, OK/SUB/DEL, max insertions per gap=2. No forced acoustic alignment and no modified acceptable phones.
outer_folds: Unchanged dual_graph_v1 primary5 and sensitivity7 training/development/test speaker roles.
selection: Each method independently chooses among the same eight candidates by unweighted mean AP over leave-one-training-speaker-out validation splits; exact ties use listed order. Every inner fold recomputes priors and numeric transforms using only inner training speakers. Inner fitting-row priors exclude both the row's speaker and inner validation speaker.
calibration: Original nondecreasing Platt and F1 threshold fitted using the original development speaker only after configuration selection; development labels never select candidates.
diagnosis: This bounded branch optimizes binary error detection only; candidate_event is unspecified and specific feedback is unauthorized.

feature_definitions.2: log(SUB mass / OK mass) in the fixed graph.
feature_definitions.3: log(DEL mass / OK mass) in the fixed graph.
feature_definitions.4: CF occurrence shift: log((learned SUB+DEL)/learned OK) - log(0.1/0.9), occurrence alpha=50, effective_tokens=1000, source fallback below20tokens or2speakers.
feature_definitions.5: CF identity support: log(dot(generic SUB posterior, q_tempered)/dot(generic SUB posterior, q_uniform)); learned q uses alpha10 and original fallback policy, masks blank and text-acceptable phones; q_tempered=r*q_learned+(1-r)*q_uniform, r=n_source_SUB/(n_source_SUB+10)*min(1,n_source_SUB_speakers/2). No SUB posterior mass gives zero support.
feature_definitions.compression: Every numeric cue uses fixed sign(x)*log1p(abs(x)) before fitted transforms.
feature_definitions.phone_design: 39 fixed phone intercept indicators; no phone-by-cue interactions. Numeric cue slopes are shared across phones.
feature_definitions.normal_rank: Training-only QuantileTransformer, <=256 quantiles, normal distribution, fixed seed20260905. Never refitted on development/test inputs.

training: Equal total weight per fitting speaker; logistic max_iter1200; HGB60iterations,minleaf40,l2=10,learning_rate0.05,no early stopping; fixed seed20260905; CPU threadpool2.
one_pass: Write both cohorts and all four methods without joining outer gold. Parent evaluates after all registered branches are frozen. No candidate changes or rerun after outer evaluation.
